items.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
items.summary: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

items.title: Bitcoin-Milliarden: Bekommen betrogene Anleger den Kursgewinn?
items.summary: Mit dem Geld betrogener Anleger kaufte eine Chinesin Bitcoin, deren Wert den Schaden heute um Milliarden übersteigt. China, London und 16.000 Opfer streiten nun um den Gewinn. Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
items.summary: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

items.title: Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
items.summary: Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.

items.title: Chinese Prosecutors Seek to Confiscate $5.1B in Bitcoin Seized by UK in Qian Case
items.summary: A Tianjin court will hear the application after a six-month notice period, while a parallel fight over the same coins continues in London.

items.title: Asian stocks tumble, bitcoin retreats as China enters bear market

items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $1.08 billion over three trading sessions to push October flows back above water.

items.title: Frankreichs Schuldenkrise spitzt sich zu: Wird Bitcoin zum Krisengewinner?
items.summary: Schon bei der Zypern-Krise 2013 profitierte Bitcoin von geschlossenen Banken und Kapitalkontrollen. Wiederholt sich das jetzt in Frankreich? Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO
